segments.he: הַזּוֹרֵק גֵּט לְאִשְׁתּוֹ, וְהִיא בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתָהּ אוֹ בְּתוֹךְ חֲצֵרָהּ – הֲרֵי זוֹ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת. זְרָקוֹ לָהּ בְּתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ אוֹ בְּתוֹךְ חֲצֵרוֹ, אֲפִילּוּ הוּא עִמָּהּ בַּמִּטָּה – אֵינָהּ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת. לְתוֹךְ חֵיקָהּ אוֹ לְתוֹךְ קַלְתָּהּ – הֲרֵי זוֹ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In a case of «one who throws a bill of divorce to his wife, and she is in her house or in her courtyard» at the time, then «she is divorced» as though he placed the bill of divorce in her hand. If «he threw it to her in his house or in his courtyard, even if» the bill of divorce «is with her in the bed, she is not divorced.» If he threw the bill of divorce «into her lap, or into her basket» [«kaltah»], «she is divorced,» even if she was in her husband’s house at the time.

moves.summary: rules on where a thrown get effects divorce

positions.claim: divorced if thrown into her house/courtyard, lap or basket; not if into his house or courtyard even in bed with her
